operations.command:
set -ex
readlink -f /run/current-system > /var/tmp/e2e-good-system
readlink /nix/var/nix/profiles/system | sed 's/^system-\([0-9]*\)-link$/\1/' > /var/tmp/e2e-good-generation
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
grep -F "init=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$default"
echo kept-in-persist > /etc/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept
echo kept-in-var > /var/lib/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept
cp /etc/machine-id /var/tmp/e2e-machine-id
sync
printf good-generation-recorded

set -ex
host=/etc/nixos/config/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/default.nix
sed -i '/settings.disk.immutability.mode =/a\  boot.initrd.systemd.services.e2e-bad-generation = { requiredBy = [ "immutability.service" "sysroot.mount" ]; before = [ "immutability.service" "sysroot.mount" ]; unitConfig.DefaultDependencies = false; serviceConfig.Type = "oneshot"; script = "echo E2E-BAD-GENERATION > /dev/console; exit 1"; };' "$host"
grep -F e2e-bad-generation "$host"
nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot
bad=$(readlink /nix/var/nix/profiles/system | sed 's/^system-\([0-9]*\)-link$/\1/')
test "$bad" -gt "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-generation)"
readlink -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/system > /var/tmp/e2e-bad-system
test "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-bad-system)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)"
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
grep -F "init=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-bad-system)/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$default"
grep -lF "init=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)/init" /boot/loader/entries/*.conf
printf %s "$bad" > /var/tmp/e2e-bad-generation
sync
printf bad-generation-is-default

set -ex
good=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)
test "$(readlink -f /run/booted-system)" = "$good"
grep -F "init=$good/init" /proc/cmdline
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
selected=$(tr -cd 'a-z0-9.-' < /sys/firmware/efi/efivars/LoaderEntrySelected-4a67b082-0a4c-41cf-b6c7-440b29bb8c4f)
test "$selected" != "$default"
grep -F "init=$good/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$selected"
grep -F "init=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-bad-system)/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$default"
test "$(cat /etc/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept)" = kept-in-persist
test "$(cat /var/lib/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept)" = kept-in-var
cmp /etc/machine-id /var/tmp/e2e-machine-id
printf older-generation-booted-from-menu

set -ex
host=/etc/nixos/config/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/default.nix
sed -i '/e2e-bad-generation/d' "$host"
if grep -F e2e-bad-generation "$host"; then exit 1; fi
if ! printf 'n\n' | nixosctl update > /var/tmp/e2e-repair.log 2>&1; then tail -n 80 /var/tmp/e2e-repair.log; exit 1; fi
fixed=$(readlink /nix/var/nix/profiles/system | sed 's/^system-\([0-9]*\)-link$/\1/')
test "$fixed" -gt "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-bad-generation)"
test "$(readlink -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/system)" = "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)"
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
grep -F "init=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$default"
sync
printf good-generation-is-default-again

set -ex
good=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-good-system)
test "$(readlink -f /run/booted-system)" = "$good"
grep -F "init=$good/init" /proc/cmdline
default=$(sed -n 's/^default //p' /boot/loader/loader.conf)
selected=$(tr -cd 'a-z0-9.-' < /sys/firmware/efi/efivars/LoaderEntrySelected-4a67b082-0a4c-41cf-b6c7-440b29bb8c4f)
test "$selected" = "$default"
grep -F "init=$good/init" "/boot/loader/entries/$selected"
test "$(cat /etc/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept)" = kept-in-persist
test "$(cat /var/lib/nixos/e2e-bad-generation-kept)" = kept-in-var
cmp /etc/machine-id /var/tmp/e2e-machine-id
printf good-generation-boots-by-default
